CFML Language Reference: Functions

SetProfileString

Sets an entry in a section of an initialization file. The entry is replaced if it exists and added otherwise; a missing section or file is created.

Category

System functions

Syntax

SetProfileString(iniPath, section, entry, value)

Parameters

iniPath
Absolute path of the .ini file.
section
The section name, without the square brackets.
entry
The entry name.
value
The value to write.

Returns

An empty string.

Usage

The rest of the file is preserved line by line. Read entries back with GetProfileString.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET IniFile = GetTempDirectory() & "snippet_" & CreateUUID() & ".ini">
<CFSET SetProfileString(IniFile, "Dialer", "Modem", "US Robotics Sportster")>
<CFSET SetProfileString(IniFile, "Dialer", "Speed", "28800")>
<CFSET SetProfileString(IniFile, "Browser", "Name", "Netscape Navigator 4.7")>
<!--- upgrade day: replace an existing entry --->
<CFSET SetProfileString(IniFile, "Dialer", "Speed", "56000")>
<CFFILE ACTION="READ" FILE="#IniFile#" VARIABLE="Contents">
<CFFILE ACTION="DELETE" FILE="#IniFile#">
<P>The file now contains:</P>
<CFOUTPUT><PRE>#HTMLEditFormat(Contents)#</PRE></CFOUTPUT>

See also

GetProfileString, GetTempDirectory, CFREGISTRY, CFFILE
